messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-transcribe-medium-0149", "row_sha256": "b365f62a521876303ecfbf72a6809badc4ce48b362a31bb66f2345342b00933f", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "hi lena i'm forwarding the visitor note from this morning about the audio guide the family at gallery four said the track for the blue room started before they reached the doorway and the volume button was hard to find on the handset they were using unit twelve not the loaner with the green case their daughter followed the printed map while her father listened and they missed the short section about the harbor painting the guide did play the next track after they tapped the arrow twice but the screen stayed on the blue room title for several seconds then they asked whether the guide could be returned at the east desk instead of the lobby because they were leaving through the courtyard i told them i would check the desk hours and send them the answer later today i haven't checked yet the note also says the left earbud crackled near the stairs and the family kept it with the handset rather than swapping it at the gallery counter please add the handset number and the east desk question to the afternoon log and leave the track timing as a visitor report for now i can bring the paper note to the sound desk after lunch if that helps", "output": "Hi Lena, I'm forwarding the visitor note from this morning about the audio guide. The family at Gallery Four said the track for the blue room started before they reached the doorway, and the volume button was hard to find on the handset they were using, unit twelve, not the loaner with the green case. Their daughter followed the printed map while her father listened, and they missed the short section about the harbor painting. The guide did play the next track after they tapped the arrow twice, but the screen stayed on the blue room title for several seconds.\n\nThen they asked whether the guide could be returned at the east desk instead of the lobby because they were leaving through the courtyard. I told them I would check the desk hours and send them the answer later today. I haven't checked yet. The note also says the left earbud crackled near the stairs, and the family kept it with the handset rather than swapping it at the gallery counter. Please add the handset number and the east desk question to the afternoon log, and leave the track timing as a visitor report for now. I can bring the paper note to the sound desk after lunch if that helps."}]
